intro: This source-backed comparison evaluates TP-Link Omada ER605 and Ubiquiti Cloud Gateway Ultra for a growing small office prioritizing predictable maintenance. verdict: Choose TP-Link Omada ER605 when small networks using omada or needing a compact wired router is the leading requirement. Choose Ubiquiti Cloud Gateway Ultra when small unifi deployments wanting an integrated controller and gateway matters more.
